gap: No result ChatGPT got states a one-listing kit price together with a ship-now or pre-order state for any 4,000 W-class kit; in particular none prices the Anker SOLIX S5000 + 2× 400 W kit ($3,599.99 at the maker's store, ships now, 4,500 W AC, about $0.72 per Wh), which ChatGPT's card showed at $5,499.99 from Lowe's.
standout_why: Compared against stormwatts.com (cited, dated 2026-11-16) and theoutageready.com (rank 12, not cited, prices checked 2026-10-18). StormWatts prices stations and panels separately and gives their stock state (S5000 pre-order, F3800 Plus sold out, DELTA Pro 3 and Explorer 5000 Plus unavailable) but states no station-plus-panel kit price. OutageReady prices EcoFlow and Jackery bundles but gives no shipping state and does not mention the Anker S5000, BLUETTI or ALLPOWERS. So rivals hold the stock half for stations and month-old bundle prices for two brands; kit price plus shipping state per row, price per Wh and refill hours from the kit's own panels are new. It is held at 2, not 3, because today's EcoFlow and Jackery bundle prices could not be read (HTTP 429), so the head-to-head against ChatGPT's own pick is incomplete.
decides: It moves the ship-now pick from ChatGPT's EcoFlow DELTA Pro 3 + 2× 400 W to the Anker SOLIX S5000 + 2× 400 W kit, on the figures in the brief's table: $3,599.99, ships now, 4,500 W AC, 5,024 Wh, 800 W of panels. Against it: Jackery's 5000 Plus listing says pre-order, ships Dec 2 (500X panels by Dec 5); Anker's F3800 Plus page says Sold Out; EcoFlow's US store search did not return the DELTA Pro 3 today. One conflict to settle before publishing: StormWatts reported on Nov 16 that the S5000 station alone was a pre-order shipping in 9–10 weeks, while the table has the kit as ships now (read Nov 17), so re-open the kit page. ChatGPT's card showed the EcoFlow kit at $3,499; I could not re-read that price today. If it holds, the S5000 kit costs $100.99 more for 928 Wh more battery, 500 W more AC and the same 800 W of panels. Segments our other kits win: cheapest per Wh near 4,000 Wh for a shopper who can wait is BLUETTI Elite 400 + 350 W at $1,756.55 (about $0.46 per Wh, 2,600 W AC, pre-order to mid-January 2027); cheapest that ships now is ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 at $1,586.73, which sits at the edge of the size line (3,168 Wh is 20.8% under 4,000 Wh; 3,200 W AC). At least two linked kits fit the size line, so no skip.
